summary: The agent implements a K-fold cross-validation setup using LightGBM and CatBoost, but blindly averages their predictions without tuning the ensemble weights. Additionally, the preprocessing pipeline applies NLP techniques (TF-IDF) and LabelEncoding to all columns indiscriminately, which would destroy the ordinality of any numerical features by treating them as strings. Finally, the agent fails to compute or log any offline validation metrics, making it impossible to evaluate the model's quality prior to submission.
